sloka: महतापि महाबाहुः प्रत्ययेन महाबलः ।प्रेषितो रावणेनैव सह वीरैर्मदोत्कटैः ।। ५.५८.१२७ ।।।।
transliteration: mahatāpi mahābāhuḥ pratyayena mahābalaḥ ।preṣito rāvaṇenaiva saha vīrairmadotkaṭaiḥ ।। 5.58.127 ।।।।

translations.english: "Thinking that Indrajit will surely kill me, the strongarmed mighty Ravana again sent intoxicated demon warriors.
